item.title: What is the difference between phone portrait and landscape modes?
item.description: Portrait mode and landscape mode are the two fundamental ways your phone displays content based on how you hold the device. Portrait mode is vertical orientation (taller than wide), whilst landscape mode is horizontal orientation (wider than tall). Your phone automatically detects which way you're holding it through built-in accelerometers and gyroscopes.
